title: Understanding Cross-Validation
text: In 4-fold cross-validation, the dataset is divided into $$4$$ equal parts. Each part is used once as a test set while the remaining parts are used for training. Think about how many times each data point is used in training and testing.

title: Training and Testing in Cross-Validation
text: Remember, in 4-fold cross-validation, each fold acts as a test set once. The remaining folds are used for training. How does this affect the number of times each data point is used in training?
